notes:
Race Engineer 0.7.0

A polish release. Nothing about fuel, pit or tyre strategy changed - this is
about the two screens that were fighting you: the update window and the race
history detail.

Updating

* You are told when it worked. After an update the app used to come back with
  nothing said about whether it had succeeded. It now confirms the new version
  once, and only after a version really went up - a normal launch and an
  automatic rollback stay quiet.
* You are told what is about to happen. The update window now explains that
  Race Engineer will close and reopen by itself, and that your history and
  settings are untouched.
* You are told it is happening. Accepting the update shows a clear "updating"
  state instead of the window simply vanishing.
* The window fits the release notes instead of forcing you to scroll through a
  fixed little box, and its buttons can no longer end up off the bottom of the
  screen.
* "Update now" can no longer fail silently. If it cannot start - because you
  connected to iRacing in the meantime, for instance - it says so and stays on
  this version.

Also

* The version you are running is now shown in the header, next to the app
  name - it was nowhere in the app before, so there was no way to tell which
  build you were on.

Race history

* The session detail now uses the width of the window instead of a fixed strip
  at the bottom. For a 180-lap race it showed about five rows; now it shows the
  session in full, side by side with the session list, and a drag bar lets you
  rebalance the two.
* The active tab is highlighted. Pit stops, laps and race summary used to look
  identical whichever one was open.
* The race summary no longer shows two scrollbars side by side, and the mouse
  wheel works over the stint table - it previously did nothing there.
* The car and track list is easier to scan: car, track and session count on
  their own lines rather than one long wrapped sentence.
* Nothing is cut off any more - not the last tab, not the right-hand columns of
  the session list - and the window can no longer open taller than your screen.
